description: Reproduces the round-35 checker bug: a derived_from entry citing general legal doctrine rather than a single pinpoint source (e.g. a 'judicial gloss' note) is built with url=None by design, since there is no one page a mechanical fetch could check. Before the round-35 fix, verify_citation fell through to the live-fetch branch for every mode (including dry-run/replay) and crashed with "Invalid URL 'None': No scheme supplied" -- a checker bug, not a real citation failure. Confirmed on Andy's first full-19-node demo-corpus live run (run_20260902T082021Z.json): 4 such entries across 3 real nodes failed this exact way. Regression guard: if this fixture ever stops CLEAN-PASSing, the round-35 null-url skip (and its all_citations_verified 'is not False' tolerance for None) has broken.
